items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: The interviewer mentions Bill Phillips and asks 'Don't you remember when you work with Billy?', but the interviewee does not respond to confirm this specific association in the provided text.

ctx.x: Do you remember who else was in those bands? No. That early band, Arnold DePox?

There's a, let me see, a guy which is called Bill Phillips, drummer. I don't know if he's working anymore, if he's still living. You see that drummer. I heard the door. I don't know if he's in sax. Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh. Don't you remember when you work with Billy? The old man, he smoked him in cigarettes.
Oh, oh, oh, oh. George Stewart. Huh?
